sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroing weak references: a weak variable does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the last strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: A shadow cannot keep a body alive; when the body goes, the shadow is erased too.

sketches.mechanism: The pin operator in a pattern match prevents rebinding and requires the new value to equal the old one, otherwise the match fails.
sketches.resonance: Memory is not assignment; it refuses to be overwritten by what comes later.

sketches.mechanism: An interface value is nil only when both its dynamic type and dynamic value are nil; a nil pointer stored in an interface becomes non-nil because it carries a type.
sketches.resonance: Absence becomes present the moment it is given a shape.
